tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Create a new free-plan API key. Save it: it is the only credential for your watches and cannot be recovered. Free.

tools.name: add_watch
tools.description: Start watching an address. kind=wallet|contract|event|safe_queue. For kind=event pass event as a signature like Transfer(address,address,uint256) or a topic0. Optional token (wallet kind: only this ERC-20) and label. Free.

tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: Show plan (free/pro), limits, alerts today and all watches for a key. Free.

tools.name: test_watch
tools.description: Send a test alert to a watch's webhook (5 per hour). Free.

tools.name: delete_watch
tools.description: Stop and delete a watch. Free.

tools.name: buy_pro_6d
tools.description: Adds 6 days of Pro to the given key (or creates a new Pro key if none is given): 30 watches, 1,000 alerts/day, Safe queued-transaction alerts, proxy-upgrade reports. Call again to extend. Price: $1 USDC per call via x402 (Base).
